rules.P: Optional prefix closed by a juncture. Two short strokes or the bent pair are P-exclusive in the source; one short stroke also has numerical uses.
rules.M: Canonical O-F-MS, optional subfields; O <=2 and F <=3 nonrepeating units. Two fish compounds are (415,220) and (032,220) in RTL order. MS is (704/705/706/707,033).
rules.C: Residual lexical cluster, permitted to be absent; its signs and boundaries cannot be identified independently for every text.
rules.T: Canonical final jar/arrow. Non-final predicates and the many extended Table 19 structures require separate annotation.
rules.indeterminate: Unanchored/complex strings, lexical fish use, uncertain P boundary, or the conflated oval class 832.
rules.scope: Conditional compatibility with the canonical pattern, not an exhaustive grammar of all 19 extended M templates.
